mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in GDPC1 (GDP) signals strong economic demand, boosting corporate earnings and investor confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 rises but 5-day forward returns are negative, or t-test p-value exceeds 0.05 in a 3-month window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in FEDFUNDS (monetary tightening) and fall in UNRATE (improving labor market) creates conflicting signals. Their combined effect lowers discount rates and boosts labor demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Trigger occurs but returns are negative, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a drop in CPIAUCSL (inflation) signals controlled price growth, reducing risk premium and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL drops in late-cycle but returns are negative, or t-test p-value > 0.05 over 2 years.

mechanism_narrative: A crossing of FEDFUNDS above 4% signals aggressive monetary tightening, raising long-term rates and compressing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS crosses above 4% but returns are positive, or IC > 0.03 over any 1-year period.

mechanism_narrative: PAYEMS crossing above 1.5 million indicates strong labor demand, boosting corporate profits and investor sentiment, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS crosses above but returns are negative, or t-test p-value > 0.05 over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in GDPC1 (GDP) and HOUST (housing demand) signal robust economic activity, driving equity gains and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Both proxies increase but returns are negative, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-month window.

mechanism_narrative: In a post-shock recovery regime, a rise in INDPRO (supply efficiency) signals improved production, lowering costs and boosting profits, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO rises in post-shock but returns are negative, or t-test p-value > 0.05 over 2 years.
